query: What legal/licensing checks, sandbox threat model (escape vectors and mitigations), and execution policy for untrusted builds will we adopt, and how will restricted artifacts be stored/published?

response.query: What legal/licensing checks, sandbox threat model (escape vectors and mitigations), and execution policy for untrusted builds will we adopt, and how will restricted artifacts be stored/published?
response.answer: Legal/licensing checks will include third-party audits; sandbox threat models will mitigate escape vectors via strict isolation; untrusted builds will be executed in a secure environment; restricted artifacts will be stored in encrypted, access-controlled repositories.
